ctx.x: Well, wonderful. Phil Hopkins is one of the great musicians.

He's a great musician. ... (smal gap in tap and it happens to picks up) Music is interpretation and/the people who are skilled enough, you know. Crazy. In voice, sometimes Babe and I have a little conversation. I think it's very necessary. She loves the theater. I think a nightclub is a theater, you know. But, that's a difference of opinion and it do make a difference. But, interpretation, her interpretation runs this way and mine runs this way so, pardon me, within that conversation interpretation it comes out…
